title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre on 1982-10-10
source: Recorded, Transferred and Mastered by N. Hoey; 2 Nakamichi CM 300 > Sony TC D-5m (Dolby B)(TDK MA-90)(FOB) Nakamichi Dragon (Dolby B decoded) > Panasonic 3800 DAT (internal A/D conversion) > Soundforge (editing) > CD Architect > Mitsui disc > Toast 9 > Xact

ai_review.summary: Warm, high‑quality audience recording of a legendary performance, hailed as one of the best shows ever.
ai_review.review: Reviewers describe this audience (AUD) capture as nearly on par with the very best soundboard tapes, noting its warmth and clarity. The show itself is praised as one of the Dead’s finest performances, earning a full‑five‑star rating.

ai_rating.rationale: Both the musical performance and the audience recording are rated exceptionally high by the reviewer; limited sample size lowers confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Warm tonal balance, clarity that approaches top‑tier soundboard recordings; no specific issues noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall flow praised as outstanding; considered one of the band’s best shows.
